note: The words the settings surfaces are made of. Authored here because both platforms say them: a row named one thing in the extension and another on the phone is one product speaking with two voices, and a one-word label is only a choice for somebody who already knows what the other options are. tools/gen_types.py writes them into both.

layer.name: Show over a word

about.browser: the page as it is; a card when you stop on a word
about.phone: the screen as it is; the circle when you want a word

about.browser: the meaning and the pronunciation, above the word
the word itself swapped for what it means; rest on it to see the word

layer.note: A browser owns the page and can make room above a line; an overlay on a phone can only paint over what an app has already drawn. So a choice carries where it is offered and, where the two differ, what it does there.

about.browser: the sounds that tell words apart
about.phone: the sounds that tell words apart

about.browser: every detail of how it is said, like aspiration and devoicing
about.phone: every detail of how it is said, like aspiration and devoicing

site.name: On this site
site.about: the default is what happens on sites you have not decided about

density.name: How often
density.about: how much of the page is annotated

target.name: I read into
target.about: the language the answers come in

source.name: This page is in
source.about: Each block is read on its own, so a page in two languages already reads correctly. Set this only where that goes wrong.

accent.name: Accent
accent.about: which accent each language is read in

dictionaries.name: Dictionaries
dictionaries.about: the words this can answer without asking anyone

host.name: Where they come from
host.about: Fetched once and kept on this machine, so a dictionary works on a train.

stress.name: Stress marks
stress.about: over a word; the card always shows them

delay.name: Rest before a card opens
delay.about: how long the cursor stays on a word before it answers

animations.name: Animations
animations.about: the card eases in; off is instant

more.name: How it reads
more.about: transcriptions, stress, how long a rest opens a card

says.no-host: Nothing is fetched until this is set.
